text: dsh-bg-plugin 是面向 DSH 网页端的全屏背景插件，通过设置面板上传和管理背景图片，并由宿主注册的本地路由读写图片与配置。用户可实时预览背景，调整面板底色、透明度、亮度、遮罩、模糊、位置和填充方式，也可选择背景并自动保存。图片和配置保存在本机背景目录，适合希望自定义 DSH 网页外观并在重启后保留设置的用户；不需要 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-bg-plugin adds a full-window background to the DSH web UI. Upload images, preview them, and adjust plate opacity, brightness, mask, blur, position, and fit in the settings panel. Images and settings persist locally across restarts; no API key or external service is needed.
想给 DSH 网页换一张自己的背景图并保存下来。
DSH 的背景能实时预览，还能调模糊和位置吗？
I want to customize the DSH web background and keep it after restarting.
dsh-bg-plugin 的功能「上传并管理背景图」：在背景设置面板选择 PNG、JPEG、GIF 或 WebP 图片，上传后自动加入图库并启用；用户可选择或删除已保存的图片。
dsh-bg-plugin 的功能「调整背景外观」：设置面板提供实时预览，可调整底色浓度、透明度、亮度、遮罩、模糊、九宫格位置和填充方式，并有按钮恢复推荐参数；更改会自动保存。

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 自定义背景插件 —— 为 `dsh web` 界面提供持久化的全窗口背景：上传图片、实时预览、调节面板实底/透明度/亮度/遮罩/模糊、选择位置与填充方式，设置持久保存。

dsh-bg-plugin README · 结构：| 目录 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `lib/` | 宿主端（Node half）：图片存储、`/bg-upload` `/bg-file` `/bg-rpc` 路由、配置持久化 |
| `client/` | 客户端（Web half）：设置面板 UI、主题 Token 渲染、fetch 上传 |
| `test/` | 宿主侧的回归测试（`node --test`，零依赖） |

两半在同一个包里：宿主侧由 `main` 指向 `lib/index.js`，客户端侧由 `exports["./client"]` 指向 `client/client.js`，`package.json` 里同时声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`。

宿主端内部按职责拆成四个模块，`lib/index.js` 只做装配：

dsh-bg-plugin README · 结构：| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/image-format.js` | 按字节签名识别 PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP，并嗅探像素宽高 |
| `lib/multipart.js` | `multipart/form-data` 解析 |
| `lib/storage.js` | 配置与图片落盘、旧格式懒迁移、孤儿回收 |
| `lib/routes.js` | 三个 HTTP 路由，含流式限额与缓存头 |

dsh-bg-plugin README · 功能：- 全窗口背景图，覆盖聊天界面
- 上传 PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP（≤16MB），服务端按**字节签名**判定格式并嗅探尺寸
- 实时预览 + 设置：**面板实底**、透明度、亮度、黑色遮罩、高斯模糊（SVG 滤镜）、位置（9 宫格）、填充方式（cover / contain / stretch）
- 默认观感为「壁纸当底纹、内容坐实底」（模糊 6 / 遮罩 12 / 面板实底 70），文字对比度不随壁纸明暗漂移；一键「恢复推荐观感」，也可把面板实底拖到 0 回到壁纸铺满
- 配置与图片落盘持久化（默认 `$DSH_HOME/background`），重启不丢失
- 关闭开关即回到原生界面，不改 DSH 任何源码

dsh-bg-plugin README · 存储：图片以**原始字节**存盘（`.dsh-bg-<id>.png|jpg|gif|webp`），配置在同目录的 `.dsh-bg-config.json`。

- 1.0.1 及更早把图片包成 `{mime, data: base64}` 的 JSON，体积大 33%，读取时还要全量解码。旧文件会在**第一次被访问时**自动迁移成原图并删掉，不需要手动处理。
- `/bg-file/<id>` 响应带 `Cache-Control: ... immutable`：id 一次生成终身不变，刷新页面不再重下图库。
- 「关闭背景并清空设置」会真正删掉图片文件与配置；启动时另有一次孤儿回收，清掉没有配置引用的残留文件（只清落盘超过 1 小时的，避免误删正在上传的图）。

dsh-bg-plugin README · 安装：**一个包**，同时含宿主半与客户端半 —— `dsh.bundle.patch` 让插件安装器接受它，`dsh.client` 让宿主在网页端加载 `exports["./client"]`。装一次就齐，不存在「只装了宿主半、设置页看不见」的状态。

```bash
dsh-bg-plugin README · 网页版 CLI（profile 换成 desktop 即为桌面版）：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-bg-plugin

dsh-bg-plugin README · dsh-bg-plugin：English | [中文](README.md)

A persistent full-window background plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI. Upload an image, preview it live, and tune the panel plate / opacity / brightness / mask / blur / position / fit. Settings persist across restarts.

dsh-bg-plugin README · Structure：| Directory | Description |
|---|---|
| `lib/` | Host half (Node): image storage, the `/bg-upload` `/bg-file` `/bg-rpc` routes, config persistence |
| `client/` | Client half (Web): settings panel UI, theme-token renderer, fetch-based upload |
| `test/` | Host-side regression tests (`node --test`, zero dependencies) |

dsh-bg-plugin README · Structure：Both halves live in one package: `main` points at `lib/index.js`, `exports["./client"]` points at `client/client.js`, and `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client` side by side.

The host half is split by responsibility; `lib/index.js` only wires things together:

dsh-bg-plugin README · Structure：| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `lib/image-format.js` | Byte-signature detection for PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP, plus pixel dimensions |
| `lib/multipart.js` | `multipart/form-data` parsing |
| `lib/storage.js` | Config and image persistence, lazy migration of the old format, orphan GC |
| `lib/routes.js` | The three HTTP routes, with streaming limits and cache headers |

dsh-bg-plugin README · Features：- A full-window background image covering the chat surface
- Upload PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP (≤16 MB); the server validates format by **byte signature** and sniffs dimensions
- Live preview plus settings: **panel plate**, opacity, brightness, black mask, Gaussian blur (SVG filter), position (3×3 grid), fit (cover / contain / stretch)
- Defaults favour readability — the wallpaper becomes a texture under a themed plate (blur 6 / mask 12 / plate 70), so contrast no longer drifts with the image; one click restores the recommended look, and dragging the plate to 0 brings back a full-bleed wallpaper
- Config and images persist to disk (default `$DSH_HOME/background`), so they survive restarts
- Flip the switch off and the stock UI returns; no changes to DSH source
dsh-bg-plugin README · Storage：Images are stored as **raw bytes** (`.dsh-bg-<id>.png|jpg|gif|webp`) next to `.dsh-bg-config.json`.

dsh-bg-plugin README · Storage：- Version 1.0.1 and earlier wrapped each image in a `{mime, data: base64}` JSON file: 33 % larger, and every read decoded the whole payload. Old files are migrated to raw images automatically the **first time they are read**, then the JSON is removed — no manual step needed.
- `/bg-file/<id>` answers with `Cache-Control: ... immutable`: an id is generated once and never changes, so refreshing the page no longer re-downloads the whole library.
- "Turn off background and clear settings" now actually deletes image files and the config. On startup there is also an orphan sweep that removes files no config references — only ones older than an hour, so an upload in progress is never collected.

dsh-bg-plugin README · Installation：This is **one package** holding both halves — `dsh.bundle.patch` makes it acceptable to the plugin installer, and `dsh.client` tells the host to load `exports["./client"]` on the web surface. One install is complete; there is no "host half only, settings page missing" state.

```bash
dsh-bg-plugin README · Web UI CLI (switch the profile to `desktop` for the desktop app)：dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-bg-plugin

dsh-bg-plugin README · Integration：`dsh-client-ui-aqua` (the glass theme) lets its wallpaper mode use whatever image this plugin currently has selected: upload or pick an image under "Settings → Background" and aqua follows it — no second upload. Turn this plugin off and aqua falls back to its fluid backdrop.

dsh-bg-plugin README · Development：- Host half: `lib/`, plain Node ESM, no build step
- Client half: `client/client.js`, browser-side React code (the `id` in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` must equal the package name)
- Dependencies: `react` (peerDependency); host services `webServer`, `sandboxPolicy`
- Verify: `npm run verify` (syntax + manifests + tests); tests alone via `npm test`
